spans.s: For अहन् is substituted अह्न when preceded by the above words (अहन् or सर्व or a word denoting a portion of night, or संख्यात or पुण्य) (and taking the affix टच् to be mentioned in राजाऽहस्सखिभ्यष्टच्‌

The अ of अहन् is elided only before the affixes ट and ख।

Terms: अ elision

The ण is the substitute of न of अहन् , when it is preceded by a word ending in अ , having in it a letter capable of producing a change.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-समास
